fullDescription:
Add a touch of retro fun to your projects with Christmas Cookie, a Groovy Bubble Font for the holidays! 🍪✌️

This chubby handwriting font features a bold, rounded style that is perfect for GoodNotes stickers, retro Christmas cards, and digital planning.

The Christmas Cinnamon and Christmas Cookie fonts are a delicious duo designed to bring festive warmth to your seasonal designs. These Christmas fonts offer distinct personalities—Cinnamon provides a tall, elegant, hand-lettered look, while Cookie features thick, “doughy” characters that feel soft and inviting. Both Christmas typefaces are perfect for Santa letters, festive planner inserts, and holiday market branding.

Whether you are using the Christmas Cinnamon font for sophisticated gift tags or the Christmas Cookie font for playful bakery labels, they work together to create a cohesive, artisanal holiday vibe. Enhance these fonts by pairing them with the included “Premium Icon Kit” for a truly custom, festive look.

✅ WHY IT WORKS:
– Stand Out: Unlike thin handwriting fonts, Christmas Cookie stands out with its bold weight and 70s-inspired vibe.
– Perfect for: Eye-catching headlines, vinyl decals (Cricut friendly!), and aesthetic planner spreads.
– Style: Cute, fun, and packed with personality.
Whether you are designing a retro sublimation shirt, printing holiday labels, or organizing your life, this cute, bold san font makes every word look sweet.

✨ PERFECT FOR:
📔 Digital Planning: Add a cozy, textured look to your Goodnotes or Procreate journals.
🥳 Holiday Stationery: Design beautiful greeting cards, gift tags, and invitations.
🧥 Sublimation & Apparel: Create stunning retro-style Christmas sweatshirts and mugs.
📚 Aesthetic Headers: Make your study notes pop with bold topics.
✅ Fun To-Do Lists: Turn boring tasks into cute checklists.
🏷️ Product Labels: Create adorable packaging for cookies and gifts.
… and any project that needs a touch of clear, friendly, and organized fun!

🎁 WHAT YOU’LL GET:
✨ Christmas Cookie Font (OTF + TTF)
✨ Optimized for Bold Headers & Stickers in Goodnotes & Remarkable Pro
✨ Full uppercase, lowercase, numbers & punctuation

❤️ BONUS INCLUDED: 3 x Planner Pages (PDF/PNG)
Designed with our popular ‘Study Mate’ Font headers!
✨ 1 x Daily Planner Page (PDF/PNG)
✨ 1 x Weekly Planner Page (PDF/PNG)
✨ 1 x Monthly Planner Page (PDF/PNG)
✨ Christmas theme (can be used both for seasonal and everyday planning)

📄 FONT FEATURES:
👉 Groovy & Retro Style: A bold, chubby look inspired by retro bubble fonts.
👉 Cricut Friendly: Thick, solid strokes make this font perfect for vinyl cutting (no tiny details to weed!).
👉 Full Character Set: Uppercase, Lowercase, Numbers, Punctuation.
👉 *Multilingual Support: Western European languages supported.

❤️ HOW TO USE:
1. Download the file after purchase.
2. Right-click the.OTF file and select “Install”.
3. Open your favorite app (Canva, Word, etc.) and start creating!
4. For Digital Planners: Import the PDF/PNG bonus pages directly into your app.
